_doc: External DPS reference for calibrating the sim, captured verbatim from arabwuwa. This file exists because the same benchmark had been pasted into chat and re-derived by hand four times, leaving every previous gap figure (2.60x, 2.09x, 1.80x) unreproducible. Hand-edit OK; it is a RECORD of an external measurement, not generated. The sim must never read it at sim time — it is for QA harnesses and tests only.
_method: Team DPS denominator is the SUM of per-member on-field times, not wall-clock: rotation 1 is 12.33 + 6.35 + 8.66 = 27.34s. Verified against every row below. 'difficulty' and 'timeWasted' are the source tool's own columns, kept for fidelity.

benchmarks._statsNote: Maintainer 2026-08-08: use the app's DEFAULT echo stats — the same baseline the recommender uses. The min/max substat spread is noticeable but far too small to explain the gap, so it is deliberately NOT part of this reference.
benchmarks._chainNote: Every member is S0 on BOTH sides. Chain-gated effects (e.g. Chisa S3.0's +120%) must not unlock, so the multiplierUp scope work does not move this benchmark.

anchors._doc: Numbers that do NOT depend on gear, so a mismatch here is a pure engine defect and cannot be argued away as a build difference.
anchors.tuneBreakNote: From the game's own LevelModifier; used 2026-08-07 to show solo Aemeath was within 1.14x, which is what localised the gap to the team-buff lane.
anchors.chisaNote: Chisa receives nothing from either teammate, yet measured 1.37x low while both others were ~2.1x low. That delta is the strongest single lead: roughly 1.5x of the gap lives in the team-buff lane, not in per-character damage.
